trip.title: Central Europe + Adriatic
trip.description: Two days each in Budapest, Prague, then over to the Dalmatian coast for sun and seafood. Mix of must-see culture, thermal baths, and beach time. Group of 4 (Maya, Anna, James, Leo).

locations.name: Split Airport (SPU)
locations.address: Cesta dr. Franje Tuđmana 1270, 21217 Kaštel Štafilić

days.title: Arrival in Budapest
days.notes: Land mid-afternoon. Take it easy — first dinner near the hotel.

days.title: Day trip: Szentendre
days.notes: HÉV suburban train from Batthyány tér; ~40 min.

days.title: Train to Prague
days.notes: Long travel day. Get a snack pack at Keleti.

days.title: Jewish Quarter & Petřín
days.notes: Funicular up Petřín if anyone's tired.

days.title: Kutná Hora day trip + jazz
days.notes: Train back by 18:00 so we don't miss the Jazz Dock set.

days.title: Split: Palace + Marjan
days.notes: Sunrise at Marjan if anyone's into it.

days.title: Ferry to Hvar
days.notes: Catamaran 13:00. Don't bring a third suitcase.

days.title: Hvar: Fortress + Pakleni boat
days.notes: Sunset from Fortica is the move.

days.title: Ferry back + fly home
days.notes: Early ferry. Pack the night before.

items.title: Flight YYZ → BUD (Air Canada AC1810)
items.notes: Overnight flight. Sleep on the plane.

items.title: Hotel Rum Budapest (4 nights)
items.notes: Two adjoining doubles on the 5th floor. Roof bar opens at 17:00.

items.title: Casual first dinner — Belvárosi Disznótoros
items.notes: No reservations — order at the counter. Try the szürkemarha sausage.

items.title: Breakfast at Centrál Café
items.notes: Get the eggs Benedict.

items.title: Parliament tour (English, 11:00)
items.notes: Tickets are per-person; bring passports. Photo ID required at entry.

items.title: Walk: Chain Bridge → Buda Castle (funicular)
items.notes: Funicular is touristy but worth it. Skip if the queue is >30 min and walk up.

items.title: Fisherman's Bastion + Matthias Church
items.notes: Upper terraces are paid; lower terraces are free and give the same view.

items.title: Dinner — Hungarian goulash (TBD)
items.notes: Anna to pick a spot — Leo allergic to paprika? confirm.

items.title: Széchenyi Thermal Bath (morning)
items.notes: Bring flip-flops. Rent towel on-site (700 HUF).

items.title: Heroes' Square + walk through City Park
items.notes: Right next to Széchenyi; do these together.

items.title: Szimpla Kert ruin bar (evening)
items.notes: Iconic. Gets packed after 22:30.

items.title: HÉV suburban train: Batthyány tér → Szentendre
items.notes: Buy ticket at the machine; tap & ride.

items.title: Wander Szentendre Old Town + Marzipan Museum
items.notes: Lunch at a Danube-side terrace.

items.title: Farewell-to-Budapest dinner
items.notes: Pick something near the hotel — early train tomorrow.

items.title: EuroCity train EC 273 'Metropolitan': Budapest Keleti → Praha hl.n.
items.notes: Reserved 4 seats together. Dining car is decent enough.

items.title: Hotel U Prince (3 nights)
items.notes: Right on Old Town Square. Rooftop terrace — go up for sunset.

items.title: First Prague dinner — Lokál Dlouhááá
items.notes: Classic Pilsner Urquell tankovna. No reservations.

items.title: Old Town Square & Astronomical Clock (top of hour)
items.notes: Be in the square 5 min before the hour.

items.title: Walk Charles Bridge → Malá Strana
items.notes: Get there before the crowds (yes, ha).

items.title: Prague Castle complex (timed entry 14:00)
items.notes: Circuit B covers St. Vitus, Old Royal Palace, Basilica, Golden Lane.

items.title: Dinner at U Medvídků (own brewery)
items.notes: Try the X-Beer 33 if anyone's brave.

items.title: Jewish Quarter walking circuit (Josefov)
items.notes: Combined ticket covers 4 synagogues + cemetery. Closed Saturdays.

items.title: Lennon Wall & Kampa Island
items.notes: Quick photo stop on the way to Petřín.

items.title: Funicular up Petřín + Lookout Tower
items.notes: Use Prague transit pass on the funicular.

items.title: Pick a dinner spot for tonight
items.notes: Open question. Maya wants Vietnamese, James votes for another beer hall. Decide by morning of.

items.title: Train Praha hl.n. → Kutná Hora hl.n.
items.notes: Buy tickets at the machine. Return train at 16:38.

items.title: Sedlec Ossuary + St. Barbara's Church
items.notes: Bone church and the cathedral. Lunch in between.

items.title: Jazz Dock evening set (20:30)
items.notes: Tickets are reserved seats — pick them up at door.

items.title: Flight PRG → SPU (Smartwings QS 1131)
items.notes: Carry-on only, no checked bags booked.

items.title: Apartment Riva Split (2 nights)
items.notes: Self check-in via keypad. Hostess sends code morning of.

items.title: Dinner: Konoba Matejuška (seafood)
items.notes: Tiny — go right at opening or book ahead.

items.title: Diocletian's Palace self-guided walk
items.notes: Cathedral bell tower climb worth it for the view.

items.title: Marjan Hill hike + sunset
items.notes: Bring water. Trail starts behind Varoš district.

items.title: Bačvice beach afternoon
items.notes: Sandy beach (rare in Croatia). Locals play picigin in the shallows.

items.title: Catamaran Split → Hvar (Krilo Jet)
items.notes: Foot-passenger only. Be at the dock 30 min before.

items.title: Villa Skansi Hvar (2 nights)
items.notes: 10 min uphill walk from port. Has a small pool.

items.title: Sunset dinner: Dalmatino Hvar
items.notes: Reservation under 'Chen'. Beef cheek is the standout.

items.title: Pakleni Islands boat day (Carpe Diem Beach)
items.notes: Water taxis leave from Hvar Riva all morning. ~5 min ride to Jerolim, longer to Palmižana.

items.title: Hike up to Fortica (Spanish Fortress) for sunset
items.notes: 20 minute uphill walk. Iconic view over Pakleni at sunset.

items.title: Ferry Hvar → Split (early)
items.notes: Walk-on. Coffee on board.

items.title: Flight SPU → YYZ (return, multi-leg)
items.notes: SPU→FRA→YYZ. Cost is in the day-1 outbound booking.

comments.body: Leo — confirm if paprika is actually a problem? Most Hungarian dishes will have it.

comments.author: usr_01HXLEOPRTNR0000000000000Z
comments.body: Mild paprika is fine. Just no hot paprika cream.

comments.author: usr_01HXJAMESWE0000000000000Z
comments.body: I'm voting Vietnamese, Sapa Restaurant near Holešovice has been recommended a few times.

comments.author: usr_01HXLEOPRTNR0000000000000Z
comments.body: Photos look amazing. The uphill walk with bags will be brutal in 30°C heat though — should we look at a luggage transfer?

comments.author: usr_01HXMAYAORG0000000000000Z
comments.body: Reminder for everyone: the train leaves at 07:25 — we leave the hotel at 06:30 sharp.
